purpose: Fixed-configuration transfer check of the ETTh1-passing AutoCon representation-gated Mamba/persistence blend on ETTh2 and ETTm2.
research_question: Does the frozen AutoCon representation-gated blend improve exact MambaTSv3 on ETTh2/ETTm2 and approach the strongest linear/patch baseline without any retuning?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only transfer screen. No test metrics or predictions are generated. No blend bias, AutoCon lambda, or capacity search is permitted.
claim_boundary: A pass is only transfer evidence on two ETT variants; it cannot establish universal accuracy, a causal AutoCon effect, or an efficiency advantage.

required_before_launch: verify two ETT fingerprints and exact 24-job expansion
freeze blend bias=-4, AutoCon lambda and baseline contracts
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: The blend mode, bias=-4, AutoCon lambda=.001, baseline set, optimizer and budget are copied unchanged from the ETTh1 transfer source; no post-hoc retuning is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only the blend arm enables mamba_ts_repr_linear_expert=true; it uses the same AutoCon representation as prediction-connected fusion and adds no second Mamba scan.
capacity_fairness_contract.efficiency_boundary: A pass does not establish speed; any efficiency claim needs an independent fixed-shape resource measurement.

phases.name: blend_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen AutoCon representation-gated Mamba/persistence blend transfer arm.

phases.name: control_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Exact current-source MambaTSv3 AutoCon control without linear blend.

phases.name: baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Current-source RLinear and PatchTST references without candidate-specific switches.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: blend candidate minus exact MambaTSv3AutoCon control
comparison_contract.pass_rule: For each dataset, blend must improve exact control in at least 2/3 seeds and have mean validation MSE no worse than 2% above the strongest external baseline.

stopping_rules: If either dataset fails either gate, stop blend transfer claims for that dataset with no held-out release or bias retuning.
Do not call the blend an AutoCon causal effect because representation and blend change jointly.
Report both ETT variants and all arms, including failures.
prelaunch_gates: verify two ETT fingerprints and exact 24-job expansion
freeze blend bias=-4, AutoCon lambda and baseline contracts
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root
